prompt: A ring city around a crater lake, every house facing the water.

card.name: Crater Lake Ring City

site.text: A ring city circling a crater lake, with every house facing the water

style.text: Not specified; a warm, cohesive medieval look in stone, timber and slate roofs, with lantern light reflecting on the lake

purpose.text: A residential lakeside town where people live around a shared water centre

card.interpretation: You want a ring-shaped city around a crater lake, with every house facing the water. I took the site as a custom sculpted crater with a lake in the middle and the town on its rim, sized L. The style was not given, so I chose a medieval look. The purpose is a residential home town. The program is mostly houses and cottages turned inward, plus a lake hall, boathouse, shops and a gatehouse.
assumptions: Style was not given, so I assumed medieval.
Purpose was not given, so I assumed a residential home base.
Size set to L for a full ring around a lake.
Crater and lake need sculpting since none was specified in the land.

program.notes: Set in an unbroken ring on the crater rim, doors and windows facing the lake.
Smaller homes filling gaps in the ring, all facing the water.
Grand hall on the ring with a terrace overlooking the lake; the town's gathering place.
Wooden jetty reaching into the crater lake with boats.
Stalls along the ring street near the hall.
Outer entrance through the ring on the outward side.
